choose.when:
select cp.id , cp.name as project_name , cp.short_name, cp.serial_number, sum(c.total_price) as freight, count(c.id) as train_number from mes_building_cargo_list AS c INNER join contract_project as cp on cp.id = c.project_id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 where c.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND c.`status` IN ( 4, 8 )
and cp.name like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
and date(c.create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(c.create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
AND c.project_id in
#{projectId}
GROUP BY c.project_id

select purchase_id as id, purchase_SN as serial_number, IFNULL(sum(freight), 0) as freight, count(*) as train_number from scm_logistics_order where bool_delete_enum = 0 and inbound_review_status = 2
and purchase_SN like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
and date(create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
group by purchase_id , purchase_SN

( select lp.id, lp.license_plate, IFNULL( sum(c.total_price ), 0) AS freight, count(lp.id) as train_number from mes_building_cargo_list AS c INNER JOIN mes_building_supplier_price AS sp ON c.supplier_price_id = sp.id and sp.bool_personal_enum = 1 INNER JOIN mes_building_licence_plate as lp on lp.license_plate = sp.license_plate and lp.bool_delete_enum = 0
and lp.name like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
where c.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND c.`status` IN ( 4, 8 )
and date(c.create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(c.create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
group by lp.id )

mapper.select: select s.name, bc.name, temp.freight from ((select p.contract_sign_body_id as branch_company_id, s.id as supplier_id, CASE sp.price_type WHEN 1 THEN c.actual_weight * sp.price / 1000 ELSE sp.price END as freight from mes_building_cargo_list as c inner join mes_building_supplier_price as sp on sp.id = c.supplier_price_id inner join scm_supplier as s on s.id = sp.supplier_id inner join contract_project as p on p.id = c.project_id ) union all (select o.branch_company_id, o.supplier_id, lo.freight from scm_logistics_order as lo inner join scm_purchase_order as o on o.id = lo.order_id and o.bool_delete_enum = 1 where lo.bool_delete_enum = 0 and lo.inbound_review_status = 2 )) as temp inner join scm_supplier as s on s.id = temp.supplier_id inner join sys_branch_company as bc on bc.id = temp.branch_company_id

select slo.id, slo.create_time as ship_date, slo.license_plate, slo.loading_weight, 1 type, 0 AS bool_personal_enum, 1 change_freight, slo.freight, slo.project_ids as projectIds from scm_logistics_order as slo left join scm_supplier as ss on slo.supplier_id = ss.id and ss.bool_delete_enum = 0 where slo.bool_delete_enum = 0 and slo.inbound_review_status = 2
and ss.id = #{supplierId}
and date(slo.create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(slo.create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
order by slo.create_time desc

select ifnull(sum(actually_payment_amount), 0) from contract_supplier_payment where bool_delete_enum = 0 and audit_status = 2
and receiving_unit_id = #{supplierId}
and property_type & #{propertyType} > 0
and date(payment_date) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(payment_date) <= date(#{endDate})

choose.when:
select cp.id , cp.name as project_name , cp.short_name, cp.serial_number, sum(c.total_price) as freight, count(c.id) as train_number from mes_building_cargo_list AS c INNER join contract_project as cp on cp.id = c.project_id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 where c.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND c.`status` IN ( 4, 8 )
and cp.name like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
and date(c.create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(c.create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
AND c.project_id in
#{projectId}
GROUP BY c.project_id

select purchase_id as id, purchase_SN as serial_number, IFNULL(sum(freight), 0) as freight, count(*) as train_number from scm_logistics_order where bool_delete_enum = 0 and inbound_review_status = 2
and purchase_SN like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
and date(create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
group by purchase_id , purchase_SN

mapper.select: SELECT MAX( voucher_number ) FROM ( SELECT SUBSTRING( approval_serial_number, 8 ) AS voucher_number FROM contract_supplier_payment WHERE approval_serial_number IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING( voucher_number, 8 ) FROM contract_collection WHERE voucher_number IS NOT NULL AND voucher_number != '' UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING( voucher_number, 8 ) FROM security_deposit_and_management_cost WHERE voucher_number IS NOT NULL AND voucher_number != '' UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING( voucher_number, 8 ) FROM contract_invoice WHERE voucher_number IS NOT NULL AND voucher_number != '' ) AS a

select id, payment_amount, serial_number, actually_payment_amount from contract_supplier_payment where id in
#{id}
